oracle.note: Observable wire behaviour only. Every route, event name and envelope rule is read from the frozen compatibility record; the Rust product is a reconstruction, not a source port.

preserves: authenticated start with a numeric pid and exact PublishedConfig build identity
one catalog-issued provider/model with no credential on the wire
session create carrying the frozen ses prefix
a prompt that actually reaches one Physical Attempt
server.connected then reasoning, text and usage, settling exactly one terminal
durable re-list convergence after a cursorless severed-stream gap
byte-equivalent durable truth across a distinct-process restart with zero repeated provider call
an active prompt interrupted over HTTP, settling exactly one interrupted terminal
intentionally_excludes: tools, attachments, subagents, campaigns and their permission decisions
desktop renderer, visual-baseline and performance evidence
billable external provider requests; the acceptance provider is controlled loopback
provider selection beyond the one catalog-issued text-only target

determinism.clock: Production timestamps are injected by the named SystemClock adapter and are compared only where exact retry must preserve the original value.
determinism.identifiers: The named production ID adapter mints bounded typed-identity-safe process tokens; the stable prompt id pins retry identity.
determinism.network: The shipped binary uses its production provider/runtime path. The test-only loopback feature admits only a parsed exact http://127.0.0.1:<port> authority, and the controlled provider records bounded requests in memory.
determinism.filesystem: The witness uses a disposable service root and bounded artifact store; persisted events and attempt receipts are the replay authority.

record_contracts.actions: One executable owner and test per journey law, plus the pinned implemented disposition and frozen operationIds.
record_contracts.durable: One terminal outcome row per case. Absence and identity mismatch remain refusals rather than fabricated success.
record_contracts.state: The sorted case set, its count and disposition groups are recomputed from actions.jsonl and compared.

evidence.claim: A shipped product process closes credential propagation, catalog-issued targeting, real provider parsing, reasoning/text/usage streaming, typed failures, restart replay and interrupt laws over authenticated HTTP.
The language-neutral transcript law remains independently executable.
An empty transcript refuses every law with a named reason, so absent journey evidence cannot pass vacuously.
The durable/live event-envelope asymmetry is enforced in both directions.
The readiness consumer accepts only v2 field names and treats service generation zero as FIRST.
The corpus state is derived from actions.jsonl rather than trusted.
